name: {sc}Go to the City of Torc'qua and destroy Lord Jadoth.{sc}Go to Ravenheart Gloom and destroy the Greater Darkness.{sc}Go to the Foundry of Failed Creations and destroy the Fury.{sc}Go to the Stygian Veil and destroy the Dreadspawn Maw.{sc}Report your success in defeating the Lords of Anguish to High Priest Zhellix.{s}Speak to High Priest Zhellix to commence the assault on the Ebony Citadel of Mallyx the Unyielding.
{s}Travel to Raven's Point to begin the hunt.

[Difficulty: Master] To defeat Mallyx the Unyielding, we must break into his Ebony Citadel. However, it will not be quite so simple as just knocking on his tower door. Mallyx the Unyielding has four great servants...the General, the Fury, the Greater Darkness, and the Dreadspawn Maw...known collectively as the overlords.

These are all powerful beings unto themselves, and the four of them together would surely overwhelm any force seeking to gain entrance. Our only hope lies in destroying the overlords before attempting to confront Mallyx. If you somehow manage to defeat these overlords, return to me and we will begin preparations for a strike on the Ebony Citadel. Reward:30,000 Experience2,000 Gold2,000 Lightbringer PointsMargonite GemstoneStygian GemstoneTitan GemstoneTorment Gemstone

We Norn have a saying: "Strength is life, but strength counts for nothing without wisdom." A darting rabbit can render the hawk's strength useless. But the raven understands the power of patience and the virtue of foresight. The raven scans the world around it, constantly seeking its next meal, never knowing if food will appear in the light of day or deep amongst the shadows. The raven represents knowledge, the ultimate skill of the patient hunter. If you seek to prove your skills as a hunter, head to Raven's Point.

I hear Raven's voice on the wind; he speaks of a creature hiding in the shadows. But beware, this beast cannot be felled by strength alone. You will need the patience of Raven to meet this challenge, unless you wish to dart through the shadows like a scared, little rabbit. Do this and I shall grant you the Raven Blessing. Reward:100 Norn reputation pointsRaven BlessingLockpick
{s}Locate the cave where the captives are being held in the Dalada Uplands.

Cmon Meow. Excellent. I have another task for your attention. With the defeat the Charr have suffered here, some have begun pulling their forces back. Because of this, one of my scouts saw the Charr moving another group of <c=@Quest>prisoners</c>. They are currently being held in a cave in the <c=@Quest>Dalada Uplands</c>. I'm certain this is only transitional and if we wait too long, the Charr will move the prisoners to a more defensible gulag. This may be our best chance to save them. Get to it before the prisoners are chow.

Reward:<brx>100 Vanguard reputation points<brx>Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom<brx>

description.decoded:
<c=@warning>[Difficulty: Elite]</c> I have many stories. This unfortunate tale began only a few weeks ago. My brothers received word that the last of the Stone Summit hierophants has gathered a force of enslaved creatures. One of his slaves chafes enough at his collar to risk a message to his master's enemies and has told us that Hierophant Duncan seeks to harness the power of the recently defeated Great Destroyer's soul. My brothers rejoiced at these tidings, resolving to wait until the hierophant completed his ritual so they may stage a glorious battle. You may say it's not very Norn of me, but it might be wise for someone to confront Duncan the Black before he has the chance to harness the dead Destroyer's power.

Reward:<brx>15,000 Experience<brx>2,750 Gold<brx>

Mallyx the Unyielding has four great servants...the General, the Fury, the Greater Darkness, and the Dreadspawn Maw...known collectively as the overlords.

description.decoded:
We Norn have a saying: "Strength is life, but strength counts for nothing without wisdom." A darting rabbit can render the hawk's strength useless. But the raven understands the power of patience and the virtue of foresight. The raven scans the world around it, constantly seeking its next meal, never knowing if food will appear in the light of day or deep amongst the shadows. The raven represents knowledge, the ultimate skill of the patient hunter. If you seek to prove your skills as a hunter, head to Raven's Point.

I hear Raven's voice on the wind; he speaks of a creature hiding in the shadows. But beware, this beast cannot be felled by strength alone. You will need the patience of Raven to meet this challenge, unless you wish to dart through the shadows like a scared, little rabbit. Do this and I shall grant you the Raven Blessing. Reward:100 Norn reputation pointsRaven BlessingLockpick

objectives.decoded: {s}Travel to Raven's Point to begin the hunt.

description.decoded:
Cmon Meow. Excellent. I have another task for your attention. With the defeat the Charr have suffered here, some have begun pulling their forces back. Because of this, one of my scouts saw the Charr moving another group of <c=@Quest>prisoners</c>. They are currently being held in a cave in the <c=@Quest>Dalada Uplands</c>. I'm certain this is only transitional and if we wait too long, the Charr will move the prisoners to a more defensible gulag. This may be our best chance to save them. Get to it before the prisoners are chow.

Reward:<brx>100 Vanguard reputation points<brx>Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom<brx>

If you somehow manage to defeat these overlords, return to me and we will begin preparations for a strike on the Ebony Citadel. description.decoded:
We Norn have a saying: "Strength is life, but strength counts for nothing without wisdom." A darting rabbit can render the hawk's strength useless. But the raven understands the power of patience and the virtue of foresight. The raven scans the world around it, constantly seeking its next meal, never knowing if food will appear in the light of day or deep amongst the shadows. The raven represents knowledge, the ultimate skill of the patient hunter. If you seek to prove your skills as a hunter, head to Raven's Point.

I hear Raven's voice on the wind; he speaks of a creature hiding in the shadows. But beware, this beast cannot be felled by strength alone. You will need the patience of Raven to meet this challenge, unless you wish to dart through the shadows like a scared, little rabbit. Do this and I shall grant you the Raven Blessing. Reward:100 Norn reputation pointsRaven BlessingLockpick

objectives.decoded: {s}Travel to Raven's Point to begin the hunt.

description.decoded:
[Difficulty: Master] To defeat Mallyx the Unyielding, we must break into his Ebony Citadel. However, it will not be quite so simple as just knocking on his tower door. Mallyx the Unyielding has four great servants...the General, the Fury, the Greater Darkness, and the Dreadspawn Maw...known collectively as the overlords.

These are all powerful beings unto themselves, and the four of them together would surely overwhelm any force seeking to gain entrance. Our only hope lies in destroying the overlords before attempting to confront Mallyx. If you somehow manage to defeat these overlords, return to me and we will begin preparations for a strike on the Ebony Citadel. Reward:30,000 Experience2,000 Gold2,000 Lightbringer PointsMargonite GemstoneStygian GemstoneTitan GemstoneTorment Gemstone

description.decoded:
We Norn have a saying: "Strength is life, but strength counts for nothing without wisdom." A darting rabbit can render the hawk's strength useless. But the raven understands the power of patience and the virtue of foresight. The raven scans the world around it, constantly seeking its next meal, never knowing if food will appear in the light of day or deep amongst the shadows. The raven represents knowledge, the ultimate skill of the patient hunter. If you seek to prove your skills as a hunter, head to Raven's Point.

I hear Raven's voice on the wind; he speaks of a creature hiding in the shadows. But beware, this beast cannot be felled by strength alone. You will need the patience of Raven to meet this challenge, unless you wish to dart through the shadows like a scared, little rabbit. Do this and I shall grant you the Raven Blessing. Reward:100 Norn reputation pointsRaven BlessingLockpick

objectives.decoded: {s}Travel to Raven's Point to begin the hunt.

description.decoded:
Cmon Meow. Excellent. I have another task for your attention. With the defeat the Charr have suffered here, some have begun pulling their forces back. Because of this, one of my scouts saw the Charr moving another group of <c=@Quest>prisoners</c>. They are currently being held in a cave in the <c=@Quest>Dalada Uplands</c>. I'm certain this is only transitional and if we wait too long, the Charr will move the prisoners to a more defensible gulag. This may be our best chance to save them. Get to it before the prisoners are chow.

Reward:<brx>100 Vanguard reputation points<brx>Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Locate the cave where the captives are being held in the Dalada Uplands.

description.decoded:
<c=@Quest>Hayda</c> was looking for you, Cmon Meow. She went ahead into <c=@Quest>Sparkfly Swamp</c>, and asked that you meet her there. It's rare to see her this motivated, so I can only assume that it's something important. You'll need to speak with her to ascertain the details.

Reward:<brx>10,000 Experience<brx>Hayda joins your party.<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Meet Hayda in Sparkfly Swamp.

description.decoded:
<c=@warning>[Difficulty: Elite]</c> I have many stories. This unfortunate tale began only a few weeks ago. My brothers received word that the last of the Stone Summit hierophants has gathered a force of enslaved creatures. One of his slaves chafes enough at his collar to risk a message to his master's enemies and has told us that Hierophant Duncan seeks to harness the power of the recently defeated Great Destroyer's soul. My brothers rejoiced at these tidings, resolving to wait until the hierophant completed his ritual so they may stage a glorious battle. You may say it's not very Norn of me, but it might be wise for someone to confront Duncan the Black before he has the chance to harness the dead Destroyer's power.

Reward:<brx>15,000 Experience<brx>2,750 Gold<brx>

description.decoded:
[Difficulty: Master] To defeat Mallyx the Unyielding, we must break into his Ebony Citadel. However, it will not be quite so simple as just knocking on his tower door. Mallyx the Unyielding has four great servants...the General, the Fury, the Greater Darkness, and the Dreadspawn Maw...known collectively as the overlords.

These are all powerful beings unto themselves, and the four of them together would surely overwhelm any force seeking to gain entrance. Our only hope lies in destroying the overlords before attempting to confront Mallyx. If you somehow manage to defeat these overlords, return to me and we will begin preparations for a strike on the Ebony Citadel. Reward:30,000 Experience2,000 Gold2,000 Lightbringer PointsMargonite GemstoneStygian GemstoneTitan GemstoneTorment Gemstone

description.decoded:
We Norn have a saying: "Strength is life, but strength counts for nothing without wisdom." A darting rabbit can render the hawk's strength useless. But the raven understands the power of patience and the virtue of foresight. The raven scans the world around it, constantly seeking its next meal, never knowing if food will appear in the light of day or deep amongst the shadows. The raven represents knowledge, the ultimate skill of the patient hunter. If you seek to prove your skills as a hunter, head to Raven's Point.

I hear Raven's voice on the wind; he speaks of a creature hiding in the shadows. But beware, this beast cannot be felled by strength alone. You will need the patience of Raven to meet this challenge, unless you wish to dart through the shadows like a scared, little rabbit. Do this and I shall grant you the Raven Blessing. Reward:100 Norn reputation pointsRaven BlessingLockpick

objectives.decoded: {s}Travel to Raven's Point to begin the hunt.

description.decoded:
Cmon Meow. Excellent. I have another task for your attention. With the defeat the Charr have suffered here, some have begun pulling their forces back. Because of this, one of my scouts saw the Charr moving another group of <c=@Quest>prisoners</c>. They are currently being held in a cave in the <c=@Quest>Dalada Uplands</c>. I'm certain this is only transitional and if we wait too long, the Charr will move the prisoners to a more defensible gulag. This may be our best chance to save them. Get to it before the prisoners are chow.

Reward:<brx>100 Vanguard reputation points<brx>Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Locate the cave where the captives are being held in the Dalada Uplands.

description.decoded:

Reward:<brx>10,000 Experience<brx>Hayda joins your party.<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Meet Hayda in Sparkfly Swamp.

description.decoded:
<c=@warning>[Difficulty: Elite]</c> I have many stories. This unfortunate tale began only a few weeks ago. My brothers received word that the last of the Stone Summit hierophants has gathered a force of enslaved creatures. One of his slaves chafes enough at his collar to risk a message to his master's enemies and has told us that Hierophant Duncan seeks to harness the power of the recently defeated Great Destroyer's soul. My brothers rejoiced at these tidings, resolving to wait until the hierophant completed his ritual so they may stage a glorious battle. You may say it's not very Norn of me, but it might be wise for someone to confront Duncan the Black before he has the chance to harness the dead Destroyer's power.

Reward:<brx>15,000 Experience<brx>2,750 Gold<brx>

description.decoded:
We Norn have a saying: "Strength is life, but strength counts for nothing without wisdom." A darting rabbit can render the hawk's strength useless. But the raven understands the power of patience and the virtue of foresight. The raven scans the world around it, constantly seeking its next meal, never knowing if food will appear in the light of day or deep amongst the shadows. The raven represents knowledge, the ultimate skill of the patient hunter. If you seek to prove your skills as a hunter, head to Raven's Point.

I hear Raven's voice on the wind; he speaks of a creature hiding in the shadows. But beware, this beast cannot be felled by strength alone. You will need the patience of Raven to meet this challenge, unless you wish to dart through the shadows like a scared, little rabbit. Do this and I shall grant you the Raven Blessing. Reward:100 Norn reputation pointsRaven BlessingLockpick

objectives.decoded: {s}Travel to Raven's Point to begin the hunt.

description.decoded:
Cmon Meow. Excellent. I have another task for your attention. With the defeat the Charr have suffered here, some have begun pulling their forces back. Because of this, one of my scouts saw the Charr moving another group of <c=@Quest>prisoners</c>. They are currently being held in a cave in the <c=@Quest>Dalada Uplands</c>. I'm certain this is only transitional and if we wait too long, the Charr will move the prisoners to a more defensible gulag. This may be our best chance to save them. Get to it before the prisoners are chow.

Reward:<brx>100 Vanguard reputation points<brx>Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom<brx>

objectives.decoded: {s}Locate the cave where the captives are being held in the Dalada Uplands.

Reward:<brx>10,000 Experience<brx>Hayda joins your party.<brx>

description.decoded:
<c=@warning>[Difficulty: Elite]</c> I have many stories. This unfortunate tale began only a few weeks ago. My brothers received word that the last of the Stone Summit hierophants has gathered a force of enslaved creatures. One of his slaves chafes enough at his collar to risk a message to his master's enemies and has told us that Hierophant Duncan seeks to harness the power of the recently defeated Great Destroyer's soul. My brothers rejoiced at these tidings, resolving to wait until the hierophant completed his ritual so they may stage a glorious battle. You may say it's not very Norn of me, but it might be wise for someone to confront Duncan the Black before he has the chance to harness the dead Destroyer's power.

Reward:<brx>15,000 Experience<brx>2,750 Gold<brx>

[Difficulty: Master] To defeat Mallyx the Unyielding, we must break into his Ebony Citadel. However, it will not be quite so simple as just knocking on his tower door. Mallyx the Unyielding has four great servants...the General, the Fury, the Greater Darkness, and the Dreadspawn Maw...known collectively as the overlords.

These are all powerful beings unto themselves, and the four of them together would surely overwhelm any force seeking to gain entrance. Our only hope lies in destroying the overlords before attempting to confront Mallyx. If you somehow manage to defeat these overlords, return to me and we will begin preparations for a strike on the Ebony Citadel. Reward:30,000 Experience2,000 Gold2,000 Lightbringer PointsMargonite GemstoneStygian GemstoneTitan GemstoneTorment Gemstone

<c=@warning>[Difficulty: Master]</c> Pyre tells me we are to be allies, human. If that is so, I would warn you of a Charr named <c=@Quest>Rragar Maneater</c>. Deep within his Menagerie, he rears a new breed of creatures he intends to utilize to destroy humans, and then plans to gain position within the ranks of the Charr Legions. Thankfully, his plan has not yet come to fruition. The time to strike is now, before he completes his army of fleshreavers. Venture into <c=@Quest>Rragar's Menagerie</c>, and put an end to his operation and his life. Be sure to destroy his creations as well...even without Rragar's influence, they're savage and dangerous beasts.

Reward:<brx>7,500 Experience<brx>1,500 Gold<brx>

description.decoded:
<c=@warning>[Difficulty: Master]</c> Pyre tells me we are to be allies, human. If that is so, I would warn you of a Charr named <c=@Quest>Rragar Maneater</c>. Deep within his Menagerie, he rears a new breed of creatures he intends to utilize to destroy humans, and then plans to gain position within the ranks of the Charr Legions. Thankfully, his plan has not yet come to fruition. The time to strike is now, before he completes his army of fleshreavers. Venture into <c=@Quest>Rragar's Menagerie</c>, and put an end to his operation and his life. Be sure to destroy his creations as well...even without Rragar's influence, they're savage and dangerous beasts.

Reward:<brx>7,500 Experience<brx>1,500 Gold<brx>

description.decoded:
Hail, friend! King Jalis sent a unit of Dwarves to clear the <c=@Quest>Destroyers</c> out of <c=@Quest>Raven's Point</c>, but they've run into some trouble. Their <c=@Quest>engineer</c>, an annoying little Asura named <c=@Quest>Xapp</c>, flew out of the caverns like a bat out of Grenth's hall, screaming about how Captain Sargen's unit was under siege by Destroyers. I knew sending little ones in to do big Norn work was no better than sending cows to slaughter, but Dwarves can be quite stubborn. I can't leave my post and my father is not...erm...battle-ready at the moment. Could you lead Xapp back to his unit, kill the <c=@Quest>Destroyers</c>, and rescue <c=@Quest>Captain Sargen's unit</c>? The engineer is waiting just inside <c=@Quest>Raven's Point</c>.

Reward:<brx>5,000 Experience<brx>1,250 Gold<brx>

objectives.decoded: {sc}Find Captain Sargen's unit deep in Raven's Point.{sc}Defeat the Destroyer swarms.{s}See Olrun Olafdottir for your reward.
